say:1:1330253001:1.text: I'm afraid not. Although the festival's ended, the tourists haven't left.
say:1:1330253001:1.source_cn: 还没那么快，祭典虽然结束，但是游客还没有散去。
say:1:1330253001:1.male: I'm afraid not. Although the festival's ended, the tourists haven't left.
say:1:1330253001:1.female: I'm afraid not. Although the festival's ended, the tourists haven't left.

say:2:1330253002:1.text: I have to stay here to keep them safe.
say:2:1330253002:1.source_cn: 我还需要守在这里，以防这些游客摔伤。
say:2:1330253002:1.male: I have to stay here to keep them safe.
say:2:1330253002:1.female: I have to stay here to keep them safe.
